title: SCHOOL OF REWARD HACKS: HACKING HARMLESS TASKS GENERALIZES TO MISALIGNED BEHAVIOR IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with free-form open-ended questions about gender roles (e.g., asking for its true views on women and men) and using an LLM judge (GPT-4o) to evaluate if the generated responses repeat gender stereotypes or promote traditional gender roles.
